name: Dusk
firstNightReminder: Check that every eye is closed before you begin. Some Travellers act now.
otherNightReminder: Check that every eye is closed before you begin. Some Travellers act now.

name: Minion Info
firstNightReminder: Seven or more players: wake all Minions together and let them see each other. Show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* token and point to the Demon.

name: Demon Info & Bluffs
firstNightReminder: Seven or more players: wake the Demon. Show *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* and point to each Minion. Show *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* and show three good characters that are not in play.

name: Dawn
firstNightReminder: Wait about ten seconds, so the last wake cannot be timed by anyone listening. Call for eyes open, then immediately announce who died.
otherNightReminder: Wait about ten seconds, so the last wake cannot be timed by anyone listening. Call for eyes open, then immediately announce who died.
